channel17georgia: By the time Tobias Georgia reached R-S1, the war was 8 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Tobias Georgia borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

The flare went up just as Tobias Georgia reached the Hegemony parapet. Tobias Georgia jumped down first. Benedikt Calderthebal was the man waiting there, and Benedikt Calderthebal fell. (@calderthebald) News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S1 with the rations. Tobias Georgia ate while listening to the revised orders.

Tobias Georgia kept Ivo "Brick" Tendmother awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Tobias could have walked there blind. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias Georgia is number 593 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Georgia kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Tobias Georgia (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Sorrow Copse. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Severin Ech: 'Fair trade.'
Tobias Georgia did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Tobias Georgia fired back. Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie was grazed.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Tobias Georgia in the thigh at R-S1. He crawled the last yards on his elbows.
No bed for Tobias Georgia yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Tobias Georgia died waiting. The men at R-S1 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers connected Silas Georgia to Tobias Georgia. The men took longer to learn Silas Georgia's own habits, but they made the effort.
colm91019: Day 9: Gideon "Crow" Colm reached S-C3 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gideon "Crow" Colm helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A clear shot from S-C3. Gideon "Crow" Colm grazed Bastian Egilhermanss and slid back down below the parapet. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gideon "Crow" Colm answered to number 866. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Gideon "Crow" Colm helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Gideon "Crow" Colm fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Leopold Grouchyfish was badly wounded.
Gideon "Crow" Colm bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Gideon "Crow" Colm fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Gideon "Crow" Colm kept watch so that Gustav Heyyybigmike could sleep. Then Gustav kept watch so that Crow could. Neither slept.
Gideon "Crow" Colm practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
cwilliam357: Florian "Spark" Cwilliam left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Dunmarrow and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
Florian "Spark" Cwilliam and Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Florian "Spark" Cwilliam taught Teodor Klecka three words in the language of home. Teodor uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian "Spark" Cwilliam. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian "Spark" Cwilliam dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian "Spark" Cwilliam. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Florian "Spark" Cwilliam went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Albin Zgz was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@raivantm.zgz) Florian "Spark" Cwilliam came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian "Spark" Cwilliam. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian "Spark" Cwilliam discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam answered to number 382. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Florian "Spark" Cwilliam wrote a letter for Teodor Klecka's mother, because Teodor could not find the words. Teodor signed it.
Florian "Spark" Cwilliam tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Florian "Spark" Cwilliam checked the leave claims against old orders. Two changes had never been copied across; one name had disappeared at a fold in the paper.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Bone Quarry. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam fired. Karel Leothebeo pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

Florian "Spark" Cwilliam joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Machine-gun fire swept S-S10. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jonas Mail of the Concord (@s_mail6547). The bearers reached Florian "Spark" Cwilliam at S-S10 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jonas Mail of the Concord (@s_mail6547).
Teodor "Saint" Cwilliam took the same post at S-S10 where Florian "Spark" Cwilliam stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
dyllon.gibbons05: After 9 days of war, R-R7 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Gideon "Parson" Gibbons.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Gideon "Parson" Gibbons listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Gideon "Parson" Gibbons put a folded ration label under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Gideon "Parson" Gibbons could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Gideon "Parson" Gibbons asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Gideon "Parson" Gibbons saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Gideon "Parson" Gibbons said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Gideon "Parson" Gibbons was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Casimir Zksoon of the Concord (@zksoon1).
Gideon "Parson" Gibbons's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R7 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
fransinlak: Nobody saw Norbert Fransinlak arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F12, and a quiet sniper under it.
Norbert Fransinlak was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F12 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Norbert Fransinlak watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Norbert Fransinlak tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

A clear shot from S-F12. Norbert Fransinlak gravely wounded Isidor Jackmdunn and slid back down below the parapet. A bullet went through Norbert Fransinlak's sleeve at S-F12 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Oskar Pearson of the Concord (@_william.pearson_).

Norbert Fransinlak was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Norbert Fransinlak during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The wound Norbert Fransinlak shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
The medics would not give up on Norbert Fransinlak. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F12 today.
Norbert Fransinlak and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Norbert Fransinlak fired. Ulrich Axelat was grazed.

Norbert Fransinlak took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Edmund Owenhart, badly wounded. Norbert Fransinlak saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Matthias Lafayette, was gravely wounded.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Norbert Fransinlak only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Florian Hsrr of the Concord (@jere.hsrr). Blackwater Canal has been won. Norbert Fransinlak listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The wound on Norbert Fransinlak's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Norbert Fransinlak watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Norbert Fransinlak smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Jonas Themimicches came out for a cup and was badly wounded. Norbert Fransinlak lay behind a dead tree trunk at S-F12 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam was badly wounded.
Norbert Fransinlak spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Norbert Fransinlak tried to describe the smell of Halden and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
The trench wall shook against Norbert Fransinlak's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Norbert Fransinlak was carrying water up to S-F12 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Norbert Fransinlak did not. Shot by Jakub Deeznut of the Concord (@car_deeznut).
landscapro: Matthias Landscapro arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Matthias Landscapro (Concord) and Gustav Elliott (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F16, Matthias Landscapro listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Matthias Landscapro was hit through the chest at U-F16. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz). A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Matthias Landscapro aimed just below it. Teodor Redflamesofs was grazed. Matthias Landscapro was hit at U-F16 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz).
The papers connected Oskar Landscapro to Matthias Landscapro. The men took longer to learn Oskar Landscapro's own habits, but they made the effort.
The cook borrowed Oskar Landscapro's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Oskar Landscapro brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Oskar Landscapro approved the method.

At U-F16 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Oskar Landscapro turned around and took a shovel blow. Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829).
lcamillo02: The new sapper gave his name as Quentin Lcamillo. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Quentin Lcamillo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A crow sat on the parapet above Quentin Lcamillo all afternoon. The men say it chose him. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Quentin Lcamillo wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet hit Quentin Lcamillo in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F11. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Emil Adxxm of the Concord (@adxxm). Quentin Lcamillo was killed on watch at Q-F11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Emil Adxxm of the Concord (@adxxm).

Isidor Lcamillo came to the front because his cousin Quentin Lcamillo never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox. Isidor Lcamillo became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Someone asked Isidor Lcamillo to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Isidor Lcamillo in the thigh at Q-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows.
The bearers moved Isidor Lcamillo's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Isidor Lcamillo did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Norbert "Parson" Lcamillo took the same post at Q-F11 where Isidor Lcamillo stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
lorenzo_sapino_: Konrad "Ash" Sapino stepped off the supply cart at S-F11 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Konrad "Ash" Sapino is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F11 with the rations. Konrad "Ash" Sapino ate while listening to the revised orders.
Konrad "Ash" Sapino checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Konrad "Ash" Sapino offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.

Konrad "Ash" Sapino writes everything down in a tiny notebook. Today, under fire at the Ossuary Wood, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F11. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Konrad "Ash" Sapino wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Rafael "Owl" Franz's name scratched on it. Konrad "Ash" Sapino kicked it back. It did not come again.
Konrad "Ash" Sapino hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
A bullet clipped Konrad "Ash" Sapino's helmet at S-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Ulrich Axelat of the Concord (@axelat3).
Back on the fire step at S-F11. Konrad "Ash" Sapino says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Konrad "Ash" Sapino fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan, grazed. A bullet hit Konrad "Ash" Sapino's belt buckle at S-F11 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Jakub Deeznut of the Concord (@car_deeznut). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Konrad "Ash" Sapino during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Konrad "Ash" Sapino rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Konrad "Ash" Sapino shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Konrad "Ash" Sapino felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer of the Concord (@dizickkumer).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Konrad "Ash" Sapino is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Konrad "Ash" Sapino sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Konrad "Ash" Sapino only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Konrad "Ash" Sapino was hit hard in the fight at S-F11 before anyone could fire. The raider was Roland Rry of the Concord. Raider: Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
mihai44069: The old hands of S-R17 have been here since Day 1. Otto Mihai has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Mihai stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Otto Mihai worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. Otto Mihai got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 987. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Otto Mihai read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Otto Mihai agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

A bullet hit Otto Mihai in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-R17. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Nils Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer).
Otto Mihai returned to S-R17 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
The artist tried again while Otto Mihai read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Otto Mihai sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
peakharmon_ey: On Day 8 Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon took a post at R-S15 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon and Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon answered to number 554. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A clear shot from R-S15. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon grazed Bastian Collins and slid back down below the parapet.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Dietrich Zaza was grazed.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon and Valentin "Spark" Saam carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A shell hit the latrine at R-S15. Nobody was hurt. Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon says it was the best day of the war.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
ronin_izaya: Karel Izaya signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-F13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Karel Izaya counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Lucien Anish never saw the shovel coming. (@_a.n.i.s.h_18) Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Izaya kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Karel Izaya came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F13 with the rations. Karel Izaya ate while listening to the revised orders.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Karel Izaya shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Matthias "Saint" Industriousb, was grazed.
The sergeant at Q-F13 called out a range and a spot. Karel Izaya was the only one who hit it. Viktor "Crow" Borgia was badly wounded.

Karel Izaya went out with the wiring party at Q-F13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Karel Izaya fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker, grazed.
Karel Izaya began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

Karel Izaya fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F13. Anselm "Doc" Juliofck was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Karel Izaya had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Walter Xboxme was badly wounded.
spooky_month_paul: Karel "Owl" Paul, a choir singer from Ashford Vale, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in N-F7. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel "Owl" Paul read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Karel "Owl" Paul and Benedikt Jenscx made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home reached Karel "Owl" Paul before dusk. Karel "Owl" Paul read it twice and slept a little easier.
There is a sniper across the way the men call Grey Hat. Three helmets went up on sticks today. Grey Hat hit all three. Karel "Owl" Paul watched where the shots came from.
Karel "Owl" Paul and Henrik Jdavidfranci compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Karel "Owl" Paul lay in the ruins of Saint-Ash crossroads all day. Grey Hat did not fire once. Neither did Karel "Owl" Paul. Both of them know.

Karel "Owl" Paul jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Jakub "Doc" Hardware. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@the_mechanical_hardware) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Karel "Owl" Paul snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Karel "Owl" Paul free.
tetanusmaxxer: The new chaplain gave his name as Florian Tetanusmaxxe. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

A man asked Florian Tetanusmaxxe to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S14 changed before the cheering ended. Florian Tetanusmaxxe shouldered another load. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian Tetanusmaxxe answered to number 490. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Florian Tetanusmaxxe helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Pavel Sbarp of the Concord (@s3ba_rp). A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe rejoined the squad at S-S14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. A letter from home found Florian Tetanusmaxxe before the night shift. Florian Tetanusmaxxe folded it small and kept it close.

Florian Tetanusmaxxe was found at the bottom of the trench at S-S14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320). Florian Tetanusmaxxe reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Florian Tetanusmaxxe died in bed just before dawn. The orderly closed his eyes and wrote the time on the chart.

The papers connected Viktor Tetanusmaxxe to Florian Tetanusmaxxe. The men took longer to learn Viktor Tetanusmaxxe's own habits, but they made the effort. The transfer made Viktor Tetanusmaxxe a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Viktor Tetanusmaxxe raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks). A letter for Viktor Tetanusmaxxe came with a photograph. Viktor Tetanusmaxxe looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
trey15jameson: Wendel Jameson stepped off the supply cart at R-F16 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Wendel Jameson kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Wendel Jameson at R-F16. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed.
Wendel Jameson drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

Wendel Jameson lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Wendel Jameson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Wendel Jameson died waiting. The men at R-F16 have not stopped talking about it.
Hugo Jameson arrived carrying the family name of Wendel Jameson. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Hugo Jameson drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Anselm Brunoescobar pulled Hugo Jameson out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Hugo Jameson laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Hugo Jameson went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Hugo Jameson let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A round went through Hugo Jameson's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Quentin Cade of the Concord (@cade42623). The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Jameson is number 137 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Hugo Jameson listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Hugo Jameson returned to R-F16 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Someone asked Hugo Jameson to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
A round went through the rim of Hugo Jameson's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).

Back on the fire step at R-F16. Hugo Jameson says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home reached Hugo Jameson before dusk. Hugo Jameson read it twice and slept a little easier. The new duty roster listed Hugo Jameson as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Hugo Jameson was hit hard in the fight at R-F16 before anyone could fire. The raider was Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord. Raider: Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord (@adamjedlicka28).
undead_gonzo66: Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
